title: Alive Bali Wellness & Mental Health Retreat | 5 Star Beachfront Luxury
description: Experience Alive’s luxury Bali wellness and mental health retreat. A 5 star beachfront retreat with private villas and exclusive residences, delivering world class, high end, personalised retreat experiences.

blocks.text: Alive Luxury Bali Retreat
An Exclusive 5 Star Beachfront Luxury Bali Retreat. Private Villas and Residences Designed for Complete Seclusion, Five Star Care and the Kind of Transformation That Lasts a Lifetime.
A Private Luxury Sanctuary for healing

Overlooking the stunning beachfront, the luxury wellness and mental health retreat in Bali is hosted at a luxury beachfront resort surrounded by tropical gardens, swaying palms, breathtaking ocean views, and natural tranquillity.

With waterfalls in the back yard and central to all that Bali has to offer including secluded beaches, volcanoes to hike and emerald green rice fields this is a space to breathe, reset, and reconnect, making this the perfect sanctuary for your truly life-changing holistic Bali retreat experience.

Offering privacy for our VIP guests in your own beachfront villa within the resort or for our Elite guests you own expensive solo private residence off site, you enjoy a choice of luxury accommodation to complement your retreat experience and receive a uniquely personalised program only focused on you.
With 5 star service, butlers and of course your full wellness team you can slide into peace with ease where as each day passes you find yourself again.
Every element of your stay invites calm, clarity, and deep renewal supported by world-class facilitators, personalised care, and the warm, attentive hospitality that makes Bali truly unforgettable.
This is your sanctuary to reset, reconnect, and rediscover who you are.
The Alive Bali Wellness Retreat is where your next chapter begins.
About The Retreat Space

✓ Private ocean view pool villas with expansive indoor and outdoor living, multiple areas to relax and reset, and complete seclusion within a sleek boutique beachfront retreat, or ultra luxury five star private residences where your entire retreat is delivered exclusively to you
✓ Expansive tropical grounds with palm-lined pathways, open space, and stunning infinity pools overlooking the ocean
✓ A fully equipped fitness centre and natural outdoor spaces for movement, walking, and restoring energy and private yoga, meditation and healing spaces
✓ A divine spa offering deeply restorative treatments designed to relax the body and release built up tension
✓ A refined restaurant experience offering exceptional dining
✓ Seamless five star service throughout your stay, including 24 hour reception, full security, housekeeping, concierge, and attentive guest support
✓ Private drivers , allowing you to move effortlessly between the retreat and curated off-site experiences
View Packages
Luxury Private Accommodation
Step into a space where everything slows down and nothing is expected of you.

Your private villa becomes your own world, a place to wake up slowly, move at your own pace, and feel fully taken care of without needing to think about anything. Indoor and outdoor living flows effortlessly, with space to rest, reflect, and reset in complete privacy.
Whether you are by your pool, in your room, or overlooking the ocean, there is a sense of calm and separation from the outside world that allows you to truly switch off.

For those choosing a private residence, this experience is taken even further. Complete seclusion, expansive living, and your entire retreat delivered exclusively to you, allowing you to reset in total privacy, without interruption.

Food From The Earth
Gourmet whole foods and detox dining

Enjoy the Alive tropical health-food dining experience, crafted to re-energise your body, calm and clarify your mind, and support deep healing from within. Choose gourmet wholefood dining options or our celebrated Alive detox and cleanse menus customised to your needs. Every meal is a delicious blend of island–fresh ingredients, medicinal nutrition, and holistic wellness, created to help you feel alive again.
Your dining experience includes:

✓ Island-inspired whole foods across 3 restaurants each celebrating unique styles for every taste ✓ Optional nutritionist-designed menus focused on gut healing, detox, and long-term vitality ✓ Medicinal teas, herbal tonics and natural elixirs crafted fresh each day ✓ Cold-pressed juices and tropical alkaline smoothies made with Bali’s freshest produce ✓ Optional fasting programs including juice, broth, or guided nutritional fasting ✓ Custom nutritional menu plans for detox, weight loss, hormonal balance or energy reset (optional extra) ✓ Gourmet à la carte wholefood meals served three times daily ✓ Natural medicine and herbal support for deep internal restoration ✓ Freedom to dine anywhere you wish — in-suite, by the pool, or in tranquil garden spaces

blocks.text: Nature, Adventure & Retreat Surrounds

blocks.alt: private therapies for health rejuvenation and emotional healing at ali

blocks.text: Far away from the hustle of Bali tourist crowds on a secluded beach, yet close enough to all that Bali has to offer the wellness resort and wellness hub offer you a secluded space to refresh on every level. With access to real nature and unique Bali cultural experiences guests can experience the 'real Bali' as it should be.

✓ Hidden rainforest waterfalls that naturally lift your mood, clear your mind and reset your energy ✓ Volcano sunrise hikes where you watch the world awaken from above the clouds ✓ Snorkelling in crystal-clear bays filled with vibrant marine life and naturally mineral-rich water ✓ Diving in Bali’s iconic underwater realms — grounding, awe-inspiring, and deeply meditative ✓ Downhill bike rides through rice fields, ancient villages and untouched countryside ✓ Visits to sacred Balinese temples for traditional melukat (water purification) and spiritual cleansing ✓ Secluded beach explorations accessing quiet coves and pristine shorelines by private boat ✓ Nature trails and jungle walks that reconnect your senses and stabilise your nervous system ✓ Stargazing picnics on mountain ridges, where silence and sky dissolve the noise inside you ✓ Sunrise and sunset rituals that restore your circadian rhythm and emotional clarity
These experiences reconnect you with the earth, your intuition, your breath, your strength — and your life.
And unlike machines, nature also gives you something technology never can: connection — to beauty, wonder, meaning, and yourself.
This is why, at Alive, we don’t replace human connection or natural connection with devices. We don’t plug you into machines and call it healing.
We help you build an unbreakable relationship with yourself, your future, and the world you were born into… a relationship many people have lost without even realising it.
This is healing that lasts. This is transformation that stays with you for life.
Choose Your Program Focus:
Every Alive program is fully private, one to one and holistic.
Most clients find their needs span all three areas; the focus simply determines where we begin and what we prioritise.
Your team handles the rest.
